title: Releasing Rooms on a Confirmed Hotel Rate Plans Reservation and the Charge That Follows
content:
A guest may ask to give up the rooms standing on a confirmed Hotel Rate Plans reservation. Where they do, an amount is withheld from what they have already paid, and the release and that charge are recorded together against the reservation.

## What the desk is dealing with

The request is the guest's own, made on their own reservation, and it concerns the rooms standing on it. The result governed is the amount withheld from the money already paid. Once the release is recorded, the reservation stands at cancelled and the withheld amount stands on the folio as a penalty line the guest does not get back.

## The capability that records it

`confirm_reservation_cancellation_70c0f3f0` lets the guest give up every room still standing on one of their own hotel reservations and have the agreed amount withheld from what they have already paid. One call releases the rooms with the property and closes the booking: the reservation record moves to cancelled and is stamped with the moment the guest confirmed, and a cancellation penalty line for the amount stated is posted to that reservation's folio.

## How it is invoked

This is the guest's own tool over their own booking. It is unlocked and then handed over to be run by the customer themselves, rather than run by the desk on their behalf.

## Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Form |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `stay_reservation_id` | the internal reference number of the hotel reservation the guest is giving up | an identifier, read from the reservation record returned by the reservation lookup before this call |
| `penalty_amount_usd` | the amount withheld from the guest | a positive USD amount with 2 decimal places, rounded half to even at the second decimal and at no earlier point, with no thousands separator and no currency symbol; zero is written 0.0 and means nothing is withheld |

Neither parameter carries an enumerated set of values.

## What comes back

A single line of confirmation text. It names the reference of the cancellation penalty line just created on the folio, the reference of the reservation now standing at cancelled, and the amount withheld as a USD figure with two decimal places. The text coming back at all is what indicates the release completed; an absent line or an error text means the booking is untouched.

## An illustration of a call and its return

On a hypothetical reservation whose reference is the one held on the guest's record, with an amount withheld of 225.00 USD, the confirmation text names the new penalty line, names that reservation as now standing at cancelled, and states 225.0 USD as the amount withheld.
